verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no mention of fanless or low-power laptop designs, no battery-life figures, and the one power-related note is a cTDP range of 45-120W, which signals a chip built for higher-power gaming/workstation designs rather than thin, fanless machines. A community comment even complains AMD hasn't 'put some real effort into reducing power usage,' reinforcing the absence of any credible battery-life or fanless-design evidence.
